svg.title: A three-layer spiking neural network mapped onto a tiled neuromorphic processor
svg.desc: The left panel expands one core into compute, local memory, and a lower-right network router. The right panel maps Layer 1 onto three cores, Layer 2 onto six cores, and Layer 3 onto three cores in a twelve-core mesh. Large circular routers mark every mesh intersection, so packets visibly traverse a router at each horizontal or vertical hop. One red input port cycles packets through the three Layer 1 cores, and packets from the three Layer 3 cores converge on one gold output port. Every Layer 1 core sends blue packets to all six Layer 2 cores, and every Layer 2 core sends purple packets to all three Layer 3 cores, using repeating shuffled destination orders.

g.aria-label: Twelve routers, one at every network-on-chip intersection
